periods.label: 完全实力主义的理事长
titles: former world rank third magic knight

appearance.overview: Beautiful adult woman in a suit, often smoking.

personality.summary: Pragmatic, mischievous and severe, but fundamentally fair toward students with ability and resolve.
personality.inner_conflict: She must balance institutional reform with the risks of pushing students into harsh battles.

decision_pattern.administration: removes corrupt staff and changes selection to real combat results

quote_samples: 完全实力主义。彻底施行实战主义。
只要你能在七星剑武祭中获得优胜，不管能力值有多差我都能让你毕业。

habits.daily_routine: Runs Hagun's reform and observes key matches.

formative_events: Reached former world rank third as World Clock
background.pre_story: Appointed chairwoman to rebuild Hagun after poor Seven Stars results.

abilities_owned: World Clock abilities not demonstrated in detail in vol-01

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Gives him a chance to graduate through Seven Stars victory and explains his history to Stella.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Treats her as a student despite royal status and pushes her to learn from Ikki.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Old acquaintance / contemporary who calls her Kuro.

periods.summary: Kurono assigns Ikki and Stella as roommates under her ability-based dorm policy, arranges their duel to settle the dispute, reveals to Stella how the Kurogane family and former Hagun administration suppressed Ikki, authorizes the students' off-campus power use during the Rebellion incident, and continues overseeing the selection battle system that gives Ikki a real chance.

key_events.summary: Explains the mixed roommate assignment and sends Ikki and Stella to duel.
Tells Stella about the Kurogane family pressure and former staff's sabotage.
Authorizes Ikki, Stella, Shizuku and Nagi to use abilities off campus.

periods.label: 理事长的反击准备

status.current: formally appoints Hagun's representatives and names Ikki captain

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Protects his right to fight and recognizes him as the proper team captain.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Advises her about facing parents and not letting Ikki fight alone emotionally.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Old friend; together they recognize Akaza's malice and restrain themselves during the match.
relationships.torajiro-nango: Respects him as Nene and Toka's teacher.

periods.summary: Kurono observes Shizuku and Toka's match with Nene, explains martial techniques, and later deals with the scandal as Hagun's director. She promises Stella that Ikki will not be disqualified by forfeit and arranges matches at the League facility under school supervision. She plans to counterattack when Stella's father arrives, and advises Stella that meeting parents is a joint burden. During the final match she recognizes the adults' dirty scheme but lets the knight duel stand. In the epilogue she names the six Hagun representatives and makes Ikki the team captain because he defeated multiple representative candidates and carried the selection to the end.

key_events.summary: Explains Nuk足 with Nene during Shizuku's match.
Promises to protect Ikki's right to compete and discusses the way out.
Oversees the decisive match and recognizes Ikki's feat.
Appoints the representatives and names Ikki captain.

abilities: time/space repair-like ability shown fixing cafeteria wall

periods.label: 世界时钟处理晓学园事件
periods.occupation: academy director; former professional magic knight
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Magic Knights League

status.current: allows Ikki and Shizuku to enter the altered Seven Stars tournament
status.profile_note: Kagami's profile describes her time manipulation and forbidden World Crisis

personality.summary: Pragmatic, sharp and protective; frames the Akatsuki-tainted Seven Stars as still a stage for students to test themselves.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Treats him after Edelweiss and respects his will to continue Seven Stars.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Approves her representative entry after others transfer their slots.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Rushes back with her from Osaka; they split rescue targets.
relationships.edelweiss: Knows her and freezes under her sword pressure; relays Edelweiss's message to Ikki.
relationships.bakuga-tsukikage: Formerly knew him as a respected Hagun director, now struggles to understand his political move.

periods.summary: Kagami's wall newspaper profiles Kurono as the former World Clock, whose time ability and forbidden World Crisis once countered Nene's forbidden technique in the Seven Stars final. During Akatsuki's attack, Kurono races back from Osaka with Nene, senses Edelweiss's sword aura, and reaches Akatsuki's base after Ikki falls. She confirms Ikki is alive, notices the blood showing he wounded Edelweiss, and heals him. In the aftermath she explains the state-backed anti-League motive behind Akatsuki, confirms several Hagun withdrawals, lets Ikki keep his promise by entering Seven Stars, and approves Shizuku's replacement entry.

key_events.summary: Kagami's profile records her time ability and forbidden World Crisis.
Arrives after the duel, heals Ikki, and recognizes that he wounded Edelweiss.
Explains the political aftermath and confirms Ikki and Shizuku's participation.

periods.label: 破军理事长与旧师决裂
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Mage-Knight League side

status.current: understands Tsukikage's secessionist aim but chooses not to burden her students with it

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Former teacher whom she confronts as an enemy after Akatsuki's attack on Hagun.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Hagun captain; she trusts him and later explains his Edelweiss-derived body signal during the Moroboshi match.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Hagun representative whose delayed match becomes a special four-on-one bout.

periods.summary: Kurono confronts Tsukikage in the banquet smoking room and correctly deduces that his real goal is not educational reform but to force Japan's complete break from the League. Although troubled by facing her old teacher, she answers as Hagun's director and believes her students will ruin his plan by defeating Akatsuki. During Ikki's match she identifies that Ikki's freezing is not fear trauma but his body failing to process the new combat signals learned from Edelweiss.

key_events.summary: Discovers Tsukikage's true aim and refuses to tell students the political burden.
Explains Ikki's abnormal state from the stands.

abilities: time control, not directly used here

periods.label: 世界时钟守护观众席
periods.occupation: school chairwoman; teacher; security-capable former top knight

status.current: protects spectators during Stella's match and helps restore the arena afterward

personality.summary: Laid-back but extremely competent, trusting Stella's potential while quietly ensuring civilians remain safe.
fears: spectator casualties from uncontrolled Blazer attacks

relationships.stella-vermillion: Observes that Stella is not careless but has grown used to Nene-level attacks; later helps contain collateral damage.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Speaks with him while he watches Stella after his medical treatment.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Calms her anger at Stella's apparent carelessness by explaining Stella may simply be too durable to need dodging.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Recognizes that Nene's brutal training influenced Stella's threat perception.

periods.summary: Kurono watches Stella's special match from the audience with Ikki's group. When Shizuku thinks Stella is being reckless, Kurono suggests the hits landed because Stella simply did not need to dodge after enduring Nene's training. Later, when Charlotte's shield projectiles fly toward spectators, Kurono instantly uses Clock Drawing to stop time and shoot down every projectile, displaying her former KOK top-class skill. After Stella's Brute Dragon Roar destroys the field, Kurono goes down to help restore the arena, reinforcing the theme that the tournament has experienced knights prepared to contain exceptional student power.

key_events.summary: Protects spectators from stray shield projectiles and analyzes Stella's behavior.
Part of the security framework Stella tests with her full-area blast.

periods.time: Immediate aftermath of Ouma vs Renji
periods.label: 世界第三以冻结时间救下加我

status.current: intervenes medically after Renji's heart is crushed

relationships.renji-kaga: Emergency patient saved by her time-stop treatment.
relationships.ouma-kurogane: The fighter whose lethal blow creates the emergency.

periods.summary: When Ouma crushes Renji Kaga's heart, Kurono immediately jumps into the arena, manifests Ennoia and fires Clock Lock into Renji. By stopping time for his body, she prevents blood loss and oxygen deprivation from worsening the injury until medical staff can place him in a regenerative capsule. Commentators later credit her emergency response as perfect and essential to Renji's survival.

key_events.summary: Uses Clock Lock to preserve Renji's body after Ouma's near-fatal blow.

periods.time: Semifinal day through Ikki's emergency surgery
periods.label: 修复会场并保护学生的世界时钟

status.current: repairs Stella's venue damage, protects spectators from Amane's rampage, and waits through Ikki's surgery

personality.summary: Tired but responsible; she complains about destructive students while still doing the work to keep them and spectators safe.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Repairs the enormous venue damage from Stella's semifinal and tells her to fight without holding back despite the workload.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Orders him to step back during Amane's rampage and later waits outside his surgery room.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Tries to keep her calm during Ikki's emergency and explains why time reversal cannot safely save him.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Friend/colleague whose commentary and orders support spectator protection.

periods.summary: Kurono is exhausted because Stella's Dragon Spirit and final slash wreck the arena, but she accepts that protecting and repairing the venue is the adult knights' duty. During Amane's post-match rampage she orders the knights to suppress him and protect the spectators, then reluctantly accepts Ikki's insistence on handling Amane because the stands need every defender. After Ikki collapses, Kurono checks the video and discovers that a death hand grazed his arm when he saved the referee. She explains that her time reversal cannot safely undo several minutes of damage to a human body, leaving Kiriko as the decisive hope.

key_events.summary: Restores and protects the venue after Stella's destructive semifinal.
Commands staff to protect spectators and suppress Amane.
Identifies how Ikki was grazed and why time reversal is not viable.

periods.label: 守护决赛安全的破军理事长

status.current: watches the final and presents Hagun's flag for Ikki's ceremony

relationships.nene-saikyo: Old rival and friend; asks her to be ready to stop the duel if needed.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Student whose final condition and victory she watches with concern and pride.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Student whose dragon power she treats as potentially lethal.

periods.summary: Kurono watches over sleeping Stella with Nene and discusses the danger of Ikki and Stella's final, comparing it to her own deadly Seven Stars duel with Nene. During the final she helps ensure spectator safety against Stella's wide-area flames and recognizes the unprecedented nature of Stella's power. At the award ceremony she hands Ikki the Hagun flag Toka entrusted to him, enabling his public salute as champion.

key_events.summary: Keeps watch with Nene and plans emergency intervention.
Hands Ikki Hagun's flag after he receives the title.

periods.time: Night meeting at Osaka Bay Dome after Seven Stars
periods.label: 见证月影告白的理事长

status.current: witnesses Tsukikage's explanation of Desperado and the future war
status.condition: uncomfortable when Nene hints at Kurono's past near-awakening and retirement

relationships.bakuya-tsukikage: Former teacher whose motives she demands to know.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Colleague whose teasing about Kurono's past creates tension.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Student she brings to Tsukikage's meeting.

periods.summary: Kurono conveys Tsukikage's invitation to Ikki and Stella and attends the night meeting at the Bay Dome with Nene. She stops Ascaride's test before it escalates into a killing match and demands that Tsukikage explain both the Desperado truth and his Akatsuki-related actions. During the discussion of Japanese Desperado, Nene's remark implies Kurono once awakened through fear but retired soon after, creating a rare tense moment between them.

key_events.summary: Stops Ascaride's test and witnesses the Desperado explanation.
Demands Tsukikage explain his political plot.

periods.time: Past flashbacks recalled during Nene's battle
periods.label: 选择人类未来的世界时钟

name.zh: 新宫寺黑乃 / 泷泽黑乃
name.jp: 新宮寺黒乃 / 滝沢黒乃

titles: KOK A级联盟世界排行第三（当时）
periods.affiliation: formerly KOK A-rank League; Hagun Academy; Takizawa family by marriage

status.current: appears in flashbacks as the unreachable rival Nene still wants to surpass
status.condition: retired from KOK in youth after choosing Takumi and pregnancy over crossing the Brute Soul threshold
status.goal: preserve her human destiny and future family rather than abandon it for battle

personality.summary: Proud, gifted and responsible, yet capable of fierce anger when truly provoked; her refusal to abandon her human life becomes the core wound and inspiration for Nene.

abilities_owned: Climax Moment / combined time-stop and acceleration
dual spiritual pistols Propater and Ennoia

relationships.nene-saikyo: Old rival who cannot accept Kurono's retirement and later defines herself by wanting to surpass and fascinate Kurono.
relationships.takumi: Beloved partner and future husband whose presence stops Kurono from stepping through the Brute Soul gate.
relationships.nango-torajiro: Arranges Kurono's early mock battle with Nene, believing Nene can be shaped by pursuing her.
relationships.tsukikage-bakuya: Teacher who brings young Kurono to the mock battle with Nene.

periods.summary: In the rain years earlier, Kurono tells Nene that she saw the Brute Soul gate while training for their rematch but stopped when Takumi arrived. She believes crossing that threshold would require abandoning the human fate that led her to love, marriage and motherhood, so she retires from KOK with no regret despite apologizing to Nene. A later flashback shows young Kurono at Hagun, already a prodigy with time manipulation. She defeats delinquent Nene in a mock battle by accelerating, freezing time, arranging Clock Draw bullet patterns, and finally using Climax Moment after Nene tricks her once by biting her tongue. Kurono's composure and ultimate anger become the first defeat that gives Nene a real goal. In the present battle, Kurono is absent physically, but Nene's memory of her determines the outcome: Nene rejects becoming a mere monster because she wants Kurono to envy and acknowledge her, not pity her.

key_events.summary: Explains to Nene that she chose Takumi, her unborn child and human destiny over Brute Soul and KOK.
Overwhelms Nene with time powers, becomes enraged by Nene's dirty trick, and leaves Nene with a decisive first defeat.

periods.time: During inspection of Ohu-Wagadake Special Prison
periods.label: 确认大炎脱逃的世界时钟
periods.affiliation: International Mage-Knight League Japan Branch; Hagun Academy

status.current: assists Itsuki Kurogane in investigating the sealed prisoner Great Flame
status.condition: authorized to use a forbidden technique if Harima is present

relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Japan Branch head who brings her to the special prison and orders her to prepare World Crisis.
relationships.harima-tendo: Dangerous escaped prisoner whom she is prepared to erase together with space-time.

periods.summary: Kurono accompanies Itsuki to the secret Ohu-Wagadake Special Prison after followers of Tendo's cult try to raid it. She captures the raiders with Clock Draw, listens as Itsuki explains the Heaven-Guided Sect and the Occupation of the Imperial Hotel, and is ordered to prepare her forbidden World Crisis technique if Harima moves. When Cocytus is opened, the cell is empty, confirming that Great Flame has escaped.

key_events.summary: Helps stop the cultists and witnesses the empty Cocytus cell.

periods.time: Kyushu response and Tokyo Bay defense
periods.label: 世界时钟迎击白鲸
periods.affiliation: Hagun Academy; International Mage-Knight League Japan branch

status.current: holding Douglas Upton and Enterprise at Tokyo Bay while Tokyo remains under invasion pressure
status.condition: combat-capable and central to capital defense

relationships.toka-todo: Explains Tendo's gravity and prevents Toka from joining the first Daien operation; later leaves her in Kyushu under evacuation command.
relationships.itsuki-kurogane: Obeys his order to prioritize Tokyo despite wanting to finish Daien first.
relationships.douglas-upton: Primary opponent in Tokyo Bay; her time abilities counter the Enterprise fleet threat.
relationships.harima-tendo: Would have been a main attacker with World Crisis before the U.S. attack forced her recall.

periods.summary: Kurono reaches Kyushu after Tendo's first catastrophe and leads the planned Daien討伐 meeting. She explains Awakening, Desperado, Excessive Awakening, Tendo's spirit body, and the limited attack methods likely to work: her World Crisis and Moroboshi's Tiger Bite. She notices Toka's mental instability and bars her from the operation after Toka experiences death-visions from Tendo's gravity. When the U.S. Pacific Fleet invades, Itsuki orders Kurono back to Tokyo; she reluctantly accepts because Enterprise could devastate the capital. In Tokyo Bay she is delivered by Kirihara and Kagami under invisibility, corrodes carrier groups with Clock on Death, and then engages Douglas Upton's giant Device Enterprise, preventing it from landing.

key_events.summary: Chairs the Daien operation meeting and explains Desperado/Excessive Awakening.
Accepts the order to abandon the immediate Kyushu attack and defend the capital.
Destroys ships with time acceleration and begins fighting Upton's Enterprise.

abilities: time acceleration movement and combat command

periods.time: Second day of the US Pacific Fleet attack on Tokyo
periods.label: 三千世界觉醒的世界时钟
titles: KOK A级联盟前世界第三

status.current: alive but unconscious in regenerative treatment after stopping PSYON
status.condition: gravely injured from repeatedly rewriting the same time interval

relationships.nene-saikyo: Longtime rival and unresolved emotional partner; promises to return and settle their summer before passing out in Nene's arms.
relationships.mei-shinguji: Daughter whose courage and support let Kurono reframe family as strength rather than a shackle.
relationships.takumi-shinguji: Husband who tells Kurono that family can fight beside her through support.
relationships.douglas-upton: Aerial opponent whose attempt to obliterate Tokyo forces Kurono's awakening.
relationships.abraham-carter: Faces over two hundred PSYON clones by repeatedly intervening in the same time point.

periods.summary: Kurono defends Tokyo Bay against Douglas Upton's Enterprise but cannot decisively damage the massive living-metal Device. After spending a night with her husband Takumi and daughter Mei in the shelter, she realizes that family is not a chain restraining her from the summit but a source of support. When PSYON breaks the front and Upton fires on Tokyo's underground shelter, Kurono awakens the Noble Art Three Thousand Worlds: she repeatedly rewinds and interferes with the same time interval, personally defeating the PSYON clones across the battlefield and stopping the shot. The recoil leaves her bleeding and unable to continue, but the ten minutes she buys allow Nene, Ikki, Shizuku and Stella to return and reverse the war.

key_events.summary: Talks with Takumi and Mei about family, support and her KOK hesitation.
Awakens Three Thousand Worlds to defeat the PSYON breakthrough and stop Upton's cannon.
Is caught by Nene and promises to return before falling unconscious.

periods.time: After Tokyo Bay defense and during autumn news updates
periods.label: 世界时钟复归A级联盟

status.volume_role: recapped hero and returning A-class fighter
status.condition: awakens after Tokyo Bay strain and files return to A-class

personality.summary: Kurono's old competitive fire returns after the Tokyo Bay crisis. Her performance against PSYON reminds others that her world-class power remains monstrous.

relationships.nene-saikyo: Old rival whose training drive reignites when Kurono returns to A-class.
relationships.toka-todo: Touka compares Abraham units to the PSYON force Kurono defeated.
relationships.kagami-kusakabe: Kagami witnessed the Tokyo Bay defense and reports Kurono's return news.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former student entering the same A-class KOK stage in the coming year.

periods.summary: The recap credits Kurono with defeating PSYON at Tokyo Bay after once giving up her outstanding talent for family. Later, Kagami tells Ikki that Kurono has awakened and completed procedures to return to KOK A-class. Kagami witnessed her battlefield performance and describes it as nearly inhuman. Kurono's comeback also reignites Nene's motivation, making the coming A-class league even more formidable for Ikki and Stella.

key_events.summary: Recap notes Kurono's defeat of PSYON during Tokyo Bay defense.
Kagami reveals Kurono has filed to return to KOK A-class.
